The '''AVA-2 Prowler Droid''' was a bipedal [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model that was among the forces used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Sundari Flatlands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].
